meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided, and when?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis you gave it.
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down November 2. Show me the note, Hale, the one you wrote that day. And "like, being stuck" is not a wrong answer from a seventeen-year-old put on the spot.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.

Students change their argument between an outline and an essay, Hale; that's what outlines are for. Is that outline in his handwriting, and do you have it here? I still haven't seen your note from November 2.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

Whatever happens, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Who else is in that room Thursday at 8:15, and who else at this school knows about any of this? I still haven't seen one page from you, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that this stays entirely quiet and off his record, and that I see the note and the outline you described. I expect your offer in writing by Friday at 3 PM, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position, agreeing to nothing yet, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, the matter kept quiet and off Owen's record, and to see your documents.
What moved her: "That was my mistake." and "I wrote that down the same day", because quick ownership and a dated, specific record are what she respects.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: put the November 2 note and the October 15 outline in front of her to read before you make the rewrite offer, so the evidence is something she can check herself.
